_comment: Authored by hand, never captured. SECURITY.md forbids committing call recordings
and private call transcripts, so fixtures are written from what a clinician says
these calls sound like. Keyed by patient id.
Shape mirrors a real terminal call task from GET /v1/calls: the conversation
lives at recipients[].attempts[].transcript_turns[] with offset_seconds and a
lowercase speaker, and completion_confidence is an object. Keeping the fixture
in the real shape is the point -- a fixture in a shape the API does not return
passes tests while the live path returns nothing.
